caption:
Gas dipped below $4 a gallon. ⛽

CNN reports the national average fell to about $3.98 on Nov. 10, after AAA had it at $4.10 on Nov. 5 and $4.22 a week before that.

Less summer driving is part of the story. Crude oil above $100 a barrel is keeping a floor under prices.

Is it changing how much you drive?
